subject.title: Make Google Chat DM thread sessions configurable

question: Should Google Chat thread sessions land as `channels.googlechat.threadSessions` with a public `parentPeer` inbound-envelope helper, or should maintainers choose a different consolidated option/API shape first?
rationale: This PR adds a public config key and extends a published Plugin SDK helper, and the sibling PR proposes a similar feature with a different option shape, so automation cannot safely choose the long-term product/API contract.

options.title: Accept Current Shape After Proof
options.body: Proceed with `threadSessions` plus `parentPeer` only after generated baselines and current-head Google Chat proof are added.

options.title: Rename Or Narrow The API
options.body: Ask for a narrower Google Chat-local implementation or a renamed config option before any public SDK/config contract lands.

options.title: Consolidate With Related PR
options.body: Pause this PR and pick one canonical Google Chat thread-session branch that resolves the option naming and scope together.

recommendation.title: Accept Current Shape After Proof
recommendation.body: Proceed with `threadSessions` plus `parentPeer` only after generated baselines and current-head Google Chat proof are added.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans the routing/session path and public Plugin SDK helper surface that need the product/API decision.
